purpose: Evaluate a small set of distinct, interpretable strategy families in parallel without changing discovery-v1 or regime-research-v1. Market-state predictiveness is tested before strategy conditioning, and no family is promoted from in-sample PnL alone.

universe.selection: PnL-independent liquid MEXC perpetual universe using existing pair-screen and BTC-correlation diversification

trend_breakout.entry_concept: Donchian breakout with directional-efficiency and trend-state confirmation

ema_pullback_continuation.entry_concept: Trend continuation after causal pullback toward fast EMA while slow trend remains aligned

bollinger_mean_reversion.entry_concept: Fade statistically stretched Bollinger displacement only when directionality is low and liquidity is stable

vwap_reversion.entry_concept: Fade ATR-normalized displacement from session VWAP in non-trending states

volatility_breakout.entry_concept: Trade range expansion after volatility compression with trend and liquidity confirmation

orderflow_continuation.entry_concept: Continuation when aggressive flow, depth-flow imbalance and microprice displacement agree, subject to execution-economics gates

state_first_rules.redundancy_control: Cluster highly associated indicators and retain one representative unless a second feature shows incremental predictive information or has a pre-specified interaction rationale.

economics.risk_research: preserve stop-based MAE/MFE analysis with 1R, 2R and 3R targets
